name: mpctl-workspace
description: 给 AI Agent 用的微信公众号草稿编辑工具

scripts.lint: oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern scripts test && turbo run lint
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json turbo.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json .changeset/config.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json scripts test 'packages/*/package.json' 'packages/*/tsconfig.json' packages/extension/wxt.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json turbo.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json .changeset/config.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json scripts test 'packages/*/package.json' 'packages/*/tsconfig.json' packages/extension/wxt.config.ts
